newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian Terme Catez sees stable 96 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian Terme Catez sees stable 96 net profit.

text.p: Slovenian health resort operator Terme Catez said on Monday 1996 net profit is expected to remain at about 365 million tolars ($2.47 million) in spite of bad weather throughout the summer season.
"Keeping our profit close to 1995 figures is a big success in view of the disastrous summer we had with only one sunny weekend," Zvonko Krulc, deputy chief executive of Terme Catez told Reuters.
Sales are expected to climb six percent to 2.2 billion tolars.
"This year's profit should be some 15 percent higher than last year's. I expect all the best for this year, it is impossible to have a worse year than the past one," Krulc said.
The company, which expects to float its shares abroad by the end of this year, said it had not yet determined a dividend for 1996. In 1995 it paid out 420 tolars per share.
By 1050 GMT on Monday, Terme Catez stock had surged 3.64 percent to 15,650 tolars on volume of 1,834 shares
